data.name: Aditya Bansod
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Aditya Bansod has made a big mark in cricket. With 67 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 65*, with an average of 18.09 and a quick strike rate of 131.78. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 48 sixes and 112 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 157.0 overs, taking 55 wickets at an economy rate of 8.19. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
